name: Production Starter Boilerplate Skeleton
description: Standardized application baseline pre-built with Auth, Profile, Layout, Sidebar, Navbar, Dashboard, and Auto DB Installer.

directory_structure.composer.json: MUST be created FIRST, before any other file, then run `composer install`. DO NOT write its require block from memory — copy it VERBATIM from mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.composer_json_template (verified via a real 7B test that skipping this and inferring packages from scattered `use` statements misses illuminate/pagination, which is a hard boot-time requirement since app/bootstrap.php registers its Paginator resolvers on every request — see verified_gotchas.eloquent_pagination_needs_separate_package).
bin: setup.php (Automated Database Creation, Migration Runner, and Default Seeder)

Controllers: ProfileController.php (Edit Profile, Change Password, Avatar Upload)
Services: AuthService.php (Bcrypt Check, Session Management, Audit Log)
ProfileService.php (Profile Update, Password Hashing, Avatar Storage)
Middleware: AuthMiddleware.php — DO NOT write from scratch. Literal code in mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.starter_middleware_pattern.auth_middleware_template

RbacMiddleware.php — DO NOT write from scratch. Literal code in mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.starter_middleware_pattern.rbac_middleware_template (this exact class crashed a real 7B test run when written ad hoc — see verified_gotchas.middleware_constructor_call_site_mismatch)
CsrfViewMiddleware.php (Must inject Slim/Csrf/Guard tokens into Twig globals) — literal code in mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.csrf_twig_globals_middleware
RateLimitMiddleware.php — DO NOT write from scratch. Literal code in mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.starter_middleware_pattern.rate_limit_middleware_template

IMPORTANT: routes/web.php MUST instantiate all three (Auth/Rbac/RateLimit) using the EXACT call sites in canonical_snippets.starter_middleware_pattern.route_wiring_matching_call_sites — never write the `new X(...)` call from memory separately from the class.

partials: navbar.twig (User Avatar, Profile Dropdown, Logout Button, Theme Toggle)
sidebar.twig (Collapsible Accordion Navigation with RBAC {% if can() %})
auth: login.twig (Clean Modern Card, CSRF Token, Loading Feedback)
dashboard: index.twig (Modern Glassmorphism KPI Summary Cards & Activity Table)

vendor.status: PRE-PROVISIONED — these files already exist in public/assets/vendor/. AI must NEVER attempt to download, fetch, or regenerate them; only reference them via local <link>/<script> tags.
vendor.js: public/assets/vendor/js/{axios.min.js, sweetalert2.all.min.js, choices.min.js, flatpickr.min.js, flowbite.min.js, app.js}

features: Automatic CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS based on .env config

Automatic seed of default Roles, Permissions, and Superadmin user (username: admin, password: randomly generated via bin2hex(random_bytes(6)) at install time, printed once to console/setup log — NEVER hardcoded as 'admin'. Seeded user gets must_change_password=1, enforced by AuthMiddleware redirecting to /profile/password until changed.)

components: Responsive Collapsible Sidebar (Mobile Drawer | Tablet Icons | Desktop Full)
Top Navbar with Profile Avatar & Logout Modal Confirmation
Page Progress Loader Bar & Axios Global Interceptors

security_features: Generic auth error message ('Username atau password salah')
CSRF Token validation on form & Axios

3_profile_management.MANDATORY_NOT_OPTIONAL: VERIFIED BY REAL 7B TESTING (2026-08-07): a fresh project's first login 404'd because GET/POST /profile/password had no route, controller method, or view — the AI had generated everything else but treated this endpoint list as descriptive rather than a hard checklist. This is NOT optional: bin/setup.php always seeds the superadmin with must_change_password=1, and AuthMiddleware always redirects there on first login (see canonical_snippets.starter_middleware_pattern.auth_middleware_template) — so /profile/password is reachable on literally the FIRST successful login of every new project. Every endpoint listed below MUST have a real route + controller method + view before the boilerplate is considered done, not just the ones a developer happens to click on first.
features: Secure Avatar Upload (MIME validation, Extension Whitelist, Random Hex Renaming)
Password Change with Current Password verification & Bcrypt hashing

components: 4 KPI Metric Cards (Total Users, Active Sessions, System Status, Quick Actions)

index_php_strict_rules.session_handling: Always start session using `$container->get(\Odan\Session\SessionInterface::class)->start();` before adding middleware. NEVER use raw `session_start();`.
index_php_strict_rules.middleware_execution_order: To avoid CSRF parsing bugs, middleware MUST be added in this exact order (which executes them correctly in LIFO): 1) CsrfMiddleware, 2) Slim\Csrf\Guard, 3) RoutingMiddleware, 4) BodyParsingMiddleware, 5) ErrorMiddleware.
index_php_strict_rules.DO_NOT_WRITE_FROM_THESE_RULES_ALONE: VERIFIED BY REAL 7B TESTING (2026-08-07): an AI following only the two rules above (without a literal file to copy) got public/index.php wrong three separate times in a row before landing on the working version. These rules explain WHY the file looks the way it does — the actual file to write is mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.public_index_php_template, copied verbatim.

boilerplate_init_command.description: How AI initializes a new project starter skeleton
boilerplate_init_command.rule: When starting a NEW project, AI automatically generates the core directory structure, bin/setup.php, and prebuilt Auth, Profile, Layout, Navbar, and Dashboard files, using the literal composer.json from mini_framework.json canonical_snippets.composer_json_template and the literal public/index.php from canonical_snippets.public_index_php_template.
boilerplate_init_command.CONTRADICTS_NO_EXTERNAL_FETCH_DO_NOT_FOL: An earlier version of this rule told the AI to 'create and run a script to download frontend libraries into public/assets/vendor/' — that directly contradicts mini_framework.json identity.rules.NO_EXTERNAL_FETCH and is now WRONG. All frontend vendor assets (Tailwind, SweetAlert2, Choices.js, Flatpickr, Axios, Flowbite, Inter font, app.js) are ALREADY PRE-PROVISIONED locally — see the 'status' note under public.assets.vendor below. NEVER write or run a download script for them.
